rules.message: Body temperature is above the normal screening threshold.
Reduced appetite can be an early sign of illness.
Diarrhea can cause dehydration and may indicate illness.

low: Continue routine observation and record any changes.
moderate: Observe closely, provide clean water and a calm environment.
Consult a veterinarian if signs persist or worsen.
high: Possible fever, infection, injury, or respiratory indicators require prompt attention.
Contact a qualified veterinarian as soon as possible.
Keep the animal separated from the herd if an infectious illness is suspected.
